proposal.patch:
diff --git a/clamp.py b/clamp.py
--- a/clamp.py
+++ b/clamp.py
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 def clamp(value: int, lower: int, upper: int) -> int:
-    return min(value, upper)
+    return max(lower, min(value, upper))
plan: Read clamp.py and tests/test_clamp.py to confirm current behavior.
Identify that clamp only applies min(value, upper), missing the lower bound.
Update clamp.py to enforce both bounds using max(lower, min(value, upper)).
Run existing public tests mentally: below lower maps to lower, above upper maps to upper, inside unchanged.
proposal.summary: Fix clamp to enforce both lower and upper bounds while preserving in-range values.
